QuestInfo.name: Zipangu's World
QuestInfo.1: Kanetsugu said something about a pillar of light and another world...maybe you should get some more details.
QuestInfo.2: According to Kanetsugu, people arrived from another world and built a new base.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: #Wbasic# #fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 621 Can proceed to the Fresh Start quest

0.0: As you know, there was a raid at Honnou-ji. By the time the alliance arrived, it was a scene of utter chaos. Nobunaga was fighting someone, but amid the din of battle, we could not tell who.
0.1: You stopped Nobunaga's ritual. I hope you remember that part because it was fine work on your part. Good job. But we were shocked to find that it was Akechi Mitsuhide's men fighting Oda's army. They revolted from within, turned on their own kind like animals! Akechi must have wanted all of Hinomaru for himself. Still, it takes some sort of warrior's spirit to stand up to Nobunaga like that. I'm not without respect for the man.
0.2: The fierce battle raged for hours. Akechi leapt from soldier to soldier, felling enemies much larger than himself with ease. I think I saw him cut a man in half! But before he could reach Nobunaga, a sizzling beam of light erupted from Honnou-ji Temple and something extraordinary happened.
0.3: The light enveloped us, seeping right into our minds, and everything went dark. When color returned to the world, we found ourselves in this unfamiliar place filled with strange creatures. Even the laws of physics do not hold entirely true with what we know.
0.4: It's a lot to process. Try to let it sink in.

no.0: The light scattered everyone to the four winds; most we know not where. For all I know, some may have been sent here, but to a different time entirely.

1.0: I myself arrived several days past, and found you as I was searching for Kenshin-Daimyo. If she's hurt, I may lay down my sword, and my life with it. A world in which I cannot defend her would be a miserable existence indeed. To be without Master Kenshin would be like a fish above water, gulping in vain at the empty air.
1.1: Anyway, I'm glad you landed so close by. We're going to need your help. Those of us who arrived first set up a base on top of this hill. Why don't you head up and get accustomed to this place? Let me show you where it is.
